pages.title: Incompressibility as a kinematic constraint
pages.text:
Incompressibility as a kinematic constraint
∇ · u = 0.
A streamfunction enforces this constraint without supplying a momentum equation or
pressure ﬁeld.

pages.title: The nullspace of a port-flow observation
pages.text:
The nullspace of a port-ﬂow observation
ψα =ψ0 +αχ, Q(χ) = 0.
Then Q(ψα) = q for every α, although the interior velocities diﬀer.
Here Q(ψ) = ψ(x,H (x)) −ψ(x, 0) is ﬂux per unit width; total ﬂow is Q =W Q(ψ).
Computational Cardiology Notes 17 / 20

pages.title: The missing dynamical constraint
pages.text:
The missing dynamical constraint
A viscous-ﬂow calculation also requires pressure, acceleration, stress and compatible
forcing or boundary data.
The streamfunction ﬁxture supplies exact kinematics, not a
solved atrial CFD model.
Computational Cardiology Notes 20 / 20
